title: Remove Approval Requests (Active)
description: Slots and bindings flagged for potential removal but awaiting explicit destructive approval. No removal until APPROVE_REMOVE is granted by form-author.

policy.description: No slot or binding may be deleted without APPROVE_REMOVE from form-author. Prefer aliasing over removal when the same data is rendered elsewhere.
constraints: No deletion without APPROVE_REMOVE from form-author.
Verify no downstream dependencies before approving.
After removal: update locked contract, republish DB, pass stable hash tests.
noActionRules: Do not remove based on REMOVE_OR_* decisions alone.
Do not remove while any remediation check is blocking.
Do not remove slots with runtime data unless migration plan exists.

removalRequests.auditBehavior: Do not suppress. Keep as REMOVE_PENDING_EXPLICIT_APPROVAL remediation item until APPROVE_REMOVE is recorded.

conflict.description: document.fullDocumentCode2 is the alias target for BM-052 document.fullDocumentCode canonical alias. Removing it would break the alias.
conflict.resolution: Form-author must decide on this request BEFORE Phase F-2B alias implementation for BM-052. If APPROVE_REMOVE: do not implement BM-052 alias. If REJECT_REMOVE: implement BM-052 alias (pending alias policy).

removalRequests.reason: Official form has one cited deposit decision, not a second full document code. The canonical document.fullDocumentCode already aliases to document.fullDocumentCode2. Removing fullDocumentCode2 may be redundant.

impactAssessment.dataLoss: If document.fullDocumentCode2 is removed and any form instance has data in that field, the data becomes inaccessible.

impactAssessment.bindingImpact: The renderBinding from document.fullDocumentCode2 to slotId document.fullDocumentCode2 must be removed or updated.
